segments.he: גְּמָ׳ אָמַר רַב תַּחְלִיפָא בַּר אַבְדִּימִי אָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל: נוֹצְרִי, לְדִבְרֵי רַבִּי יִשְׁמָעֵאל לְעוֹלָם אָסוּר.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» «Rav Taḥlifa bar Avdimi says» that «Shmuel says:» With regard to «a Christian, according to the statement of Rabbi Yishmael it is always prohibited» for a Jew to engage in business with him. Since his festival takes place every Sunday and the three days before and after Sunday constitute the entire week, one cannot engage in business with a Christian on any day of the week.
